overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation under G.L. c. 39, §23B: the ad was a discretionary staff function, and the evaluation committee was not required to be created by open vote. Matter closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board directed staff to place a newspaper ad for an police department assessment RFP without deliberating in an open meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that it was not necessary for the Board to deliberate to authorize the placement of the advertisement in question.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board created an ad hoc evaluation committee for police department assessment proposals and appointed members without a vote in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Contrary to the assertion contained in the complaint, the Board was not required to vote in open session to establish the committee and appoint its members.
